intervals.quote: The SPT has been operating at the South Pole since February 2007.

placements.locator: CMB-S4 sites page, South Pole section
placements.note: Page text: the Dark Sector is "an area about 1 km from the station". Start is the first month of operation (arXiv:0907.4445).
placements.quote: A mock-up of the Dark Sector at the South Pole, showing the current SPT and BICEP/Keck telescopes (left) together with the proposed sites for the CMB-S4 small (center and center-right) and large (right) aperture telescopes.

diameter.quote: The South Pole Telescope (SPT) is a 10 m diameter, wide-field, offset Gregorian telescope

sensor_count.quote: the three-band (90, 150, 220 GHz), 16,000-detector, polarization-sensitive SPT-3G camera

summary.plain: A ten-metre dish at the South Pole that maps microwave light from the early universe, carrying a succession of ever more sensitive cameras.
summary.technical: 10 m diameter offset Gregorian millimetre-wave telescope at the South Pole with, in turn, the SPT-SZ (966-pixel), SPTpol (1536-bolometer) and SPT-3G (~16,000-detector, 95/150/220 GHz) cameras.

technology.quote: The South Pole Telescope (SPT) is a 10 m diameter, wide-field, offset Gregorian telescope with a 966-pixel, multi-color, millimeter-wave, bolometer camera.
technology.value: 10 m diameter, wide-field, offset Gregorian telescope with a millimeter-wave bolometer camera (SPT-SZ, SPTpol, SPT-3G cameras in turn).
